metadata.title: Show-Tell: 25 More Props for Design and Learning
metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Show-Tell uses hesitant writer, definitions, Your Turn and locked spoken outro; no verdict.

beats.narration_text: Bonjour. This is Liam, in for Bear. Here are twenty-five more candidate props. Each one shows a design choice, a recovery step, or a learning action. Judge what the motion explains, not just how the icon looks.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

props.text:
Choose a prop for
how it looks.

beats.narration_text: Three terms. A control changes a setting. Recovery returns work to a usable state. Evidence supports a judgment. These drawings are teaching examples, not reports of tests we have run.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

beats.narration_text: A suggestion offers a starting point. Move the proposed instruction toward the arrow, then leave room to revise it. Suggested does not mean required.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Suggestion slip approaches the arrow
shot.motion_claim: Suggestion slip approaches the arrow

beats.narration_text: Clarification sends a question back before work continues. Separate the two directions. Use this when missing context matters more than producing an immediate answer.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Upper and lower arrows separate around the question
shot.motion_claim: Upper and lower arrows separate around the question

show.event: Upper and lower arrows separate around the question

beats.narration_text: A token can stand for a unit in a budget. Separate one segment from the rest. This is a teaching metaphor, not a literal drawing of language tokenization.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: One segment leaves the token ring
shot.motion_claim: One segment leaves the token ring

show.event: One segment leaves the token ring

beats.narration_text: A filter narrows a collection according to a rule. Move a record past successive levels. The rule must be stated; filtering alone does not make information trustworthy.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: One record passes three filtering levels
shot.motion_claim: One record passes three filtering levels

show.event: One record passes three filtering levels

beats.narration_text: Sorting changes order without changing the collection. Swap the short and long bars. Name the ordering rule before interpreting whichever item ends up first.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Short and long bars swap vertical positions
shot.motion_claim: Short and long bars swap vertical positions

show.event: Short and long bars swap vertical positions

beats.narration_text: An adaptive form asks a follow-up question only when it applies. Reveal the second field after the first choice. More fields are not automatically more useful.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Second field appears after an initial choice
shot.motion_claim: Second field appears after an initial choice

show.event: Second field appears after an initial choice

beats.narration_text: Responsive design preserves the task across different screens. Separate the desktop, tablet, and phone. The layout can change while the essential decision stays available.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Three screen silhouettes spread apart
shot.motion_claim: Three screen silhouettes spread apart

beats.narration_text: A slider makes a range adjustable. Move the handle along its track. Name what changes and provide a way to understand the selected value without guessing from position.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Handle travels on the isometric rail
shot.motion_claim: Handle travels on the isometric rail

show.event: Handle travels on the isometric rail

beats.narration_text: A toggle expresses a two-state choice. Move it from one end to the other. For a consequential action, make the current state clear before anything happens.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Knob moves from off position to on position
shot.motion_claim: Knob moves from off position to on position

show.event: Knob moves from off position to on position

beats.narration_text: Accessibility is support for completing a task, not a decorative badge. Bring the support into place beneath the figure. Then test the real experience with its users.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Support platform arrives beneath the figure
shot.motion_claim: Support platform arrives beneath the figure

show.event: Support platform arrives beneath the figure

beats.narration_text: Keyboard focus shows where the next action will land. Move the focus marker between controls. A visible ring should track navigation, not remain around the first item.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Focus marker travels between two control targets
shot.motion_claim: Focus marker travels between two control targets

show.event: Focus marker travels between two control targets

beats.narration_text: A data warning interrupts an assumption. Reveal the warning, then pull out the affected record. The next step is investigation, not turning the warning into a reassuring check.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Warning appears before a record separates
shot.motion_claim: Warning appears before a record separates

show.event: Warning appears before a record separates

beats.narration_text: A failed exchange should stop the next handoff. Bring the outgoing record to the broken connection and hold it. Do not show movement that suggests delivery succeeded.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Outgoing slip stops at the broken connection
shot.motion_claim: Outgoing slip stops at the broken connection

show.event: Outgoing slip stops at the broken connection

beats.narration_text: Undo returns from a recent action to its earlier state. Move the same record back. Keep it distinct from restoring an older backup, which may replace more work.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Record moves out and returns along the same route
shot.motion_claim: Record moves out and returns along the same route

show.event: Record moves out and returns along the same route

beats.narration_text: Restore recovers a saved state. Bring the snapshot back into the recovery ring. Name which snapshot you used, and verify what changed after the restoration.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Saved snapshot returns to the recovery ring
shot.motion_claim: Saved snapshot returns to the recovery ring

show.event: Saved snapshot returns to the recovery ring

beats.narration_text: Release history connects a deployed package to earlier decisions. Move the clock beside the package, then reveal a record. A timestamp alone cannot explain why the release changed.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Clock and record become visible beside package
shot.motion_claim: Clock and record become visible beside package

show.event: Clock and record become visible beside package

beats.narration_text: A work board makes status visible. Move one task between columns. Define what the destination means; arriving in a done column is not evidence that the work passed review.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: One task changes columns on the board
shot.motion_claim: One task changes columns on the board

show.event: One task changes columns on the board

beats.narration_text: A timeline preserves sequence. Follow the events in order. This schematic has no time scale, so the distances between events do not claim how long anything took.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Marker follows four ordered events
shot.motion_claim: Marker follows four ordered events

beats.narration_text: A metric needs a question. Move the lens toward the change in this illustrative trend. Ask what was measured and what evidence could support a different interpretation.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Lens approaches a bend in a schematic trend
shot.motion_claim: Lens approaches a bend in a schematic trend

show.event: Lens approaches a bend in a schematic trend

beats.narration_text: A table keeps records comparable. Pull one row aside while the other rows remain. Use this when the lesson depends on inspecting an individual case within a collection.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Middle row separates from the table
shot.motion_claim: Middle row separates from the table

show.event: Middle row separates from the table

beats.narration_text: A quiz asks the learner to try before seeing the answer. Move the question aside and reveal a response card. The teaching value comes from the attempt and feedback.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Question yields to a response card after a pause
shot.motion_claim: Question yields to a response card after a pause

show.event: Question yields to a response card after a pause

beats.narration_text: Reference reading connects a person to material they can inspect. Open the two pages around the reader. Show the source itself when the lesson turns on its exact wording.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Book pages separate beneath reader
shot.motion_claim: Book pages separate beneath reader

beats.narration_text: An experiment changes something so its consequences can be examined. Lower the instrument toward the sample. This prop represents a test; it does not provide a test result.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Instrument approaches the sample stage
shot.motion_claim: Instrument approaches the sample stage

beats.narration_text: A map reveals relationships that one isolated location cannot show. Unfold the three panels. For a workflow map, label the places people actually need to find.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Three folded map panels separate
shot.motion_claim: Three folded map panels separate

beats.narration_text: A milestone marks a condition worth checking. Raise the flag after the work reaches that point. Keep the milestone separate from a claim that the whole project is complete.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

shot.visual_intent: Flag rises on pole and a record arrives
shot.motion_claim: Flag rises on pole and a record arrives

show.event: Flag rises on pole and a record arrives

beats.narration_text: These twenty-five candidates are simplified adaptations of Isocons, under Creative Commons Attribution four point zero. Geometry, colors, and motion have changed. They are awaiting library selection; keep the source credit when reusing them.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one large vector prop with two clear labels; deliberate negative space.

show.event: Three map panels separate while the license stays visible

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: Use Show-Tell to explain a task I teach. Choose three props. Show a learner action, a possible failure, and the evidence needed to continue. Review the result. Can you follow the action without reading a paragraph? Does the film distinguish a symbol from evidence?
